mxCell.value: CBOE index CSVs cdn.cboe.com .../daily_prices/{SYM}_History.csv, 307 to cdn-api.cboe.com
FRED *CLS series fallback: only fills dates missing from Cboe
yfinance ^GSPC and other underlyings, VXX, SVXY; auto_adjust=False
sharpe-observatory scripts/metrics.py PSR, expected max SR, DSR (MIT, reused)
ivf.data.cli python -m ivf.data fetch | build-interim | verify | check | eda; --synthetic switches the root and the protocol
ivf.protocol strict readers of every config; protocol_hash = SHA-256 of the canonical JSON; freeze_data_end and its freeze record

ivf.repo_guard licensing guard (ADR 0001 D2): refuses a data root (and its raw, interim, processed, eda, app-data folders) or an export folder inside a git checkout, by device and inode of every ancestor and by any .git entry; write_file, the one writer, checks each folder again at write time; exit 3
ivf.data.raw store_snapshot: temp file, SHA-256, os.link to {sha256}.csv if absent; append-only provenance log
ivf.data.fetch network_get is the only network call; skip within --max-age 1 day; yfinance bytes fixed by yfinance_csv_bytes
ivf.data.synthetic seeded generator with known truth: AR(1) ln VIX, GARCH(1,1) returns; hand-set parameters, not fitted
ivf.data.build_interim strict parse; typed, deduplicated, one table per source kind; latest snapshot unless --snapshot
ivf data verify re-hash every raw file and cross-check the log; fail on any mismatch
ivf.data.check data_check, gap policy G1-G5, settled data_end; --freeze-data-end writes it once, with a freeze record; check fails if the protocol no longer matches the record
ivf.data.calendar master calendar from XNYS sessions, from dates alone; first fold cutoff
ivf.features.build trailing windows only (L1): feature, target_value, regime_label; is_backwardation, term_structure_panel (L5)
ivf.eda pure statistics: ACF, Ljung-Box, AR(1) half-life, ADF/KPSS, implied-realised gap, vol-of-vol, term structure
ivf.data.process run_id; refuses a failed data_check; writes the processed tables and the local EDA report
ivf.evaluation.splits expanding window, 63-session folds, shared by every model

ivf.models rw, hist_mean, ARIMA, HAR (M2); GARCH/GJR/EGARCH on S&P 500 returns for rv21, har_rv, vix_implied, ARIMA-GARCH on ln VIX, d = 0 (M3); lstm_log on vix_level and rv21, 5-seed mean, retrained every 4th cutoff (M4); params frozen within a fold

ivf.evaluation python -m ivf.evaluation report (M5): RMSE, MAE, MAPE, QLIKE, bias by regime; DM (fixed-b primary) with Holm; MZ (Hansen-Hodrick); walk-forward calibration variant; dev only, holdout refused on real data
ivf.backtest VXX/SVXY signals executed at close of t+1 (L7), costs, PSR/DSR; the one holdout look (M6): preflight, record, holdout refits (ivf.models.holdout), M5 holdout report, backtest
ivf.reports commits only publication set P (unitless ratios, 2 dp tests); one release per frozen data_end; needs a clean tree

configs/*.yaml M1: protocol.yaml, protocol.synthetic.yaml and their freeze records (protocol*.freeze.json), iv_indices.yaml, instruments.yaml; M2: models.yaml (model_def and the baseline settings); M3: its garch block (innovation rule, ARIMA-GARCH order); M6: backtest.yaml (pre-registered strategy_def rows, costs, trial-log location) and instruments.yaml's tradable_segments. Committed
ROOT/raw/{source}/{symbol}/{sha256}.csv bytes as downloaded; never committed
ROOT/raw/provenance.jsonl append-only, one line per fetch, written even if unchanged
ROOT/synthetic/raw/ Cboe-shaped and Yahoo-shaped CSVs named by sha256, with their own provenance.jsonl; never committed
ROOT/interim/{table}.parquet iv_index_daily, price_daily; every row keeps raw_sha256
ROOT/interim/build_report.json per raw file: raw_sha256, fetched_at, rows, duplicates dropped; local, never committed

ROOT/processed/run_id=<id>/{table}.parquet M1: run_input, calendar, data_check, feature, target_value, regime_label, eda_stat; M2 (python -m ivf.models baselines): fold, fit, forecast, metric, and calendar.fold_id; M3 (python -m ivf.models garch) merges its rv21 and arima_garch_log rows into the same fit, forecast and metric tables; M4 (python -m ivf.models lstm, after garch) merges lstm_log rows (one fit row per seed) and writes forecast_member; runs.parquet beside it
ROOT/eda/<run_id>/eda_report.json every EDA number, for reading locally; never committed (ADR 0001 D2)
forecast and fit tables under processed/run_id=<id>/; key (run_id, model_id, target_id, origin_date, horizon)

metric, dm_test, mz_regression, backtest_daily, strategy_summary under processed/run_id=<id>/; M5 writes evaluation/period=dev/ (metric, dm_test, mz_regression, calibration, calibration_summary, report_meta.json)
reports/*.agg.csv committed: publication set P only (unitless, rounded), source_dirty = false
schemas/app-data/ JSON Schemas: the single source of truth for the contract
ROOT/app-data/real/*.json never in the repo tree; the Vite dev server serves it in dev only
tools/export_app_data.py reshape, round, validate, write; computes no new number (D1). M1 real: ribbon from interim iv_index_daily, first session with all five tenors to data_end
export_app_data.py --mode synthetic --check regenerate in a temp dir and compare with the committed fixture

tools/licensing/scan_real_rows.py local only, not a test: flags a repo line that holds a raw row, a dated raw value (any date spelling), a run of 3 or more consecutive raw values, a raw file size or a raw SHA-256; prints file:line and a count, never the text; exit 0 clean, 1 flagged, 2 no raw data
tools/build_notebooks.py --check is the notebook sync test
notebooks/ generated from src/ivf; never hand-edited
app/src/lib loaders check envelope and invariants, show the data_mode badge; compute nothing
npm run verify fails if any file in dist/ has data_mode real
